commits.subject: Merge pull request #824 from zen010101/net-http-chunk-trailers
commits.body: net: consume chunk trailers before completing HTTP bodies
commits.author: ab

@@ -635,6 +635,7 @@   THttpRequestContext = record
      hrsGetBodyChunkedHexNext,
      hrsGetBodyChunkedData,
      hrsGetBodyChunkedDataVoidLine,
+     hrsGetBodyChunkedDataLastLine,
      hrsGetBodyContentLengthFirst,
      hrsGetBodyContentLengthNext,
      hrsConnect];
@@ -3839,15 +3840,27 @@ function THttpRequestContext.ProcessRead(
             exit; // not enough input
         end;
       hrsGetBodyChunkedDataVoidLine:
-        if ProcessParseLine(st) then // chunks end with a void line
-          State := hrsGetBodyChunkedHexNext
+        if ProcessParseLine(st) then
+          if st.LineLen = 0 then
+            State := hrsGetBodyChunkedHexNext
+          else
+            State := hrsErrorRejected
         else if State = hrsErrorRejected then
           break // notify the rejection now, not on the next input
         else
           exit; // not enough input
       hrsGetBodyChunkedDataLastLine:
-        if ProcessParseLine(st) then // last chunk void line
-          State := hrsWaitProcessing // notice: st.Len<>0 if pipelining
+        if ProcessParseLine(st) then
+          if st.LineLen = 0 then
+            State := hrsWaitProcessing
+          else
+          begin
+            // The last chunk set fContentLeft to zero. Bound all trailer fields
+            // and their delimiters to one header line's budget on both paths.
+            inc(fContentLeft, st.LineLen + 2);
+            if fContentLeft > MaxHttpHeaderLineSize then
+              State := hrsErrorPayloadTooLarge;
+          end
         else if State = hrsErrorRejected then
           break // notify the rejection now, not on the next input
         else
@@ -4383,8 +4396,16 @@ procedure THttpSocket.GetBody(DestStream: TStream);
       len := ParseHex0x(chunksize, {noOx=}true); // hexa chunk length
       if len = 0 then
       begin
-        SockRecvLn; // ignore next line (normally void)
-        break;      // reached the end of input stream
+        bytes := 0;
+        repeat
+          SockRecvLn(chunk);
+          if chunk = '' then
+            break;
+          inc(bytes, length(chunk) + 2);
+          if bytes > MaxHttpHeaderLineSize then
+            ESizeOverflow.RaiseFmt(self, 'GetBody: chunk trailers', []);
+        until false;
+        break;
       end;
       if len > MaxHttpChunkSize then // allow up to 256 MB chunk
         ESizeOverflow.RaiseFmt(self, 'GetBody: chunk len=%d', [len]);
@@ -4407,7 +4428,8 @@ procedure THttpSocket.GetBody(DestStream: TStream);
         SockInRead(@PByteArray(Http.Content)[Http.ContentLength], len); // append
       end;
       inc(Http.ContentLength, len);
-      SockRecvLn; // ignore next #13#10
+      if SockInReadLn(@chunksize, SizeOf(chunksize)) <> 0 then
+        EHttpSocket.RaiseUtf8('%.GetBody: invalid chunk delimiter', [self]);
     until false;
   end
   else if Http.ContentLength > 0 then

commits.subject: Merge pull request #825 from zen010101/net-http-parse-informational
commits.body: net: allow informational status codes in THttpRequestContext.ParseResponse
commits.author: ab

commits.subject: net: make TAsyncConnectionsSockets.WriteNoClose public
commits.body:
- Expose the existing write operation so callers can handle failure without an automatic close.
- Document write locking and synchronous callbacks, and exercise the public method on a live connection.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: allow informational status codes in THttpRequestContext.ParseResponse
commits.body:
- Accept status codes 100 through 199 only when the caller opts in.
- Document when the output status is valid and test both modes at their boundaries.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: consume chunk trailers before completing HTTP bodies
commits.body:
- Both readers previously mistook the first trailer field for the end of the body and ignored nonempty chunk delimiters.
- Keep ProcessRead in the trailer state until the empty line so partial lines can resume and pipelined input stays intact.
- Make GetBody consume every trailer field and reject nonempty data delimiters in both readers.
- Count each discarded field and its CRLF against MaxHttpHeaderLineSize without adding it to the headers or body.
- Test both server families on keep-alive connections, async pipelining, split CRLF, malformed delimiters, and the trailer budget boundary.
commits.author: zen010101
